ND5T.CarolingianTheme.Name: Carolingian UI Theme Harmony
ND5T.CarolingianTheme.Hint: Harmonizes Nik's Tweaks styling with Carolingian UI, automatically adopting its active color theme (Carolingian Teal, Royal Blood, Dark Sorcery, etc.) across the settings dashboard, floating HUD banners, damage prompts, and toggles, while adjusting HUD banner positioning for top scene navigation.
ND5T.WeaponMasteries.Name: Weapon Mastery Automation
ND5T.WeaponMasteries.Hint: Automatically applies weapon masteries to targets when hit by attacks. Step 1 automates Slow and Sap active effects.
ND5T.WeaponMasteries.ClientHint: Enables automatic weapon mastery effects on your client when making weapon attacks (if enabled by the GM).
ND5T.WeaponMasteries.SapIconHint: Icon used for the Sap weapon mastery active effect.
ND5T.WeaponMasteries.SlowIconHint: Icon used for the Slow weapon mastery active effect.
ND5T.RollBreakdownDetails.Name: Detailed Roll Breakdown Overlay
ND5T.RollBreakdownDetails.Hint: Replaces unlabeled roll breakdown numbers in chat popovers with a comprehensive breakdown showing base dice, attribute bonuses, proficiency, magic bonuses, and active effects.
ND5T.RollBreakdownDetails.ClientHint: Enables detailed roll breakdown popovers on your client (if enabled by the GM).
ND5T.ConditionalDamage.Name: Conditional Damage Bonuses
ND5T.ConditionalDamage.Hint: Offers toggles in damage roll configuration dialogs for Sneak Attack, Great Weapon Master (2024), Brutal Strike, Charger (2024), Savage Attacker (2024), Boon of Irresistible Offense (2024), Cleave weapon mastery malus, and active Hex or Hunter's Mark concentration effects, remembering your choices across rolls.
ND5T.ConditionalDamage.ClientHint: Offers toggles in damage rolls for Sneak Attack, Great Weapon Master (2024), Brutal Strike, Charger (2024), Savage Attacker (2024), Boon of Irresistible Offense (2024), Cleave weapon mastery malus, and active Hex or Hunter's Mark concentration effects, remembering your choices across rolls (if enabled by the GM).
